name: University of Limerick
summary: Campus university in Limerick with over 70 undergraduate courses, from Engineering and Sport Sciences to Irish music and school-leaver Medicine.

ib.text: The Diploma with 24 points for every Level 8 course, with English, Maths and another language (Irish or other). Strictest: Financial Mathematics HL Maths 6; Medicine a science and HPAT.

programmes.name: Medicine (Undergraduate Entry)
programmes.about: An integrated six-year course for school-leavers: early patient contact and case-based learning, moving from a biomedical foundation to clinical placements, with Garda Vetting and fitness to practise checks.
programmes.ib: HL 5 in two subjects and SL 4 in four more, including English, another language, a lab science and Maths. HPAT-Ireland is required.
programmes.selectionNote: HPAT-Ireland in your year of entry, and at least 480 CAO points from one sitting; points above 550 are moderated.

flagshipSource.title: UL Medicine: an integrated six-year course with early patient exposure and case-based learning

programmes.name: Financial Mathematics
programmes.about: Maths, statistics and computing applied to business, finance and banking, for people who enjoy mathematics and want a career in finance.
programmes.ib: HL Maths 6, with HL 5 in two subjects and SL 4 in four more, including English and another language.
programmes.selectionNote: Places go on CAO points. A Special Mathematics Examination is offered after results to students who miss the Maths grade.

flagshipSource.title: UL Financial Mathematics: maths, statistics and computing for careers in business, finance and banking

programmes.name: Architecture
programmes.about: Drawing, model making, CAD and design thinking alongside environmental and structural engineering, in a hands-on course fully accredited by the Royal Institute of the Architects of Ireland, with a cooperative education placement.
programmes.ib: HL 5 in two subjects and SL 4 in four more, including English, Maths and another language. A digital portfolio and statement are required.
programmes.selectionNote: A digital portfolio and written statement earn up to 200 points on top of your CAO points; the 2027 portfolio guidelines are due in October 2026.

flagshipSource.title: UL Architecture: fully accredited by the RIAI, with a cooperative education placement

programmes.name: Irish Music
programmes.about: Artistic development and the academic study of Irish traditional music, with performance at the heart of it, taught in the Irish World Academy building, plus a period of cooperative education.
programmes.ib: HL 5 in two subjects and SL 4 in four more, including English, Maths and another language. Every applicant auditions.
programmes.selectionNote: Audition in April 2027, in person or by video with a remote interview: three sets of tunes or three songs. It earns up to 200 points on top of CAO points.

flagshipSource.title: UL Irish Music: taught in the Irish World Academy building, with cooperative education

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Social Sciences
faculties.line: Every degree needs English, Maths and another language; Irish Music also auditions everyone for up to 200 extra points.

faculties.name: Faculty of Education and Health Sciences
faculties.line: Medicine asks HPAT-Ireland, 480 CAO points from one sitting and a lab science at SL 4.

faculties.name: Faculty of Science and Engineering
faculties.line: Financial Mathematics asks HL Maths 6; Architecture grades a portfolio for up to 200 extra points.

faculties.name: Kemmy Business School
faculties.line: Business Studies asks Maths at SL 5 or HL 3 with English and another language, and offers a co-op placement.

notes: Medicine (LM301) takes school-leavers for six years: HPAT in your year of entry, at least 480 points from one sitting, and one science subject.
Architecture (BArch) grades a digital portfolio and written statement for up to 200 extra points; the 2027 guidelines are due in October 2026.
BA Irish Music (LM131) auditions everyone in April 2027 for up to 200 extra points, and can still be added in Change of Mind.
